name: multicam_podcast_spice_1080
_note: Generic 1080x1920 SPICE caption preset for multicam podcast dual-color clips. Multi-weight Proxima, host=white / guest=yellow, gentle italics for quotes, soft shadow, y=60% from top (below chin). Color keys are 'host' (default) and 'guest' — multifinish.py emits voice_spans with 'guest' label for guest's spoken runs; everything else falls back to default_voice=host (white). Copy-and-tune per project if needed (font_size, sizes, y_percent).

timing._note: v2 spec Part 2 (2026-07-06): min_cue_dur 0.21s = the 5-frame ABSOLUTE floor (sequential layout: a crammed cue PUSHES the next, nothing dropped; dense cues get a +1-frame reading bump in generate_spice). onset_correct = hold a caption through a pause Groq folded into the next FUNCTION word. pause_split_s defaults to 0.25 (>=250ms silence = break) in generate_spice.
